name: aircall
description: Connect Claude to Aircall: calls, transcripts, AI summaries, contacts, SMS, users, teams and more (83 tools).
long_description:
Gives Claude access to your Aircall phone system via the Aircall Public API. Look up and search calls, read transcriptions, AI summaries, sentiments, topics and action items, manage contacts and tags, check agent availability, send SMS, and more.

You need an Aircall API ID and API Token, created in the Aircall Dashboard under Integrations & API → API Keys.

api_id.title: Aircall API ID
api_id.description: From the Aircall Dashboard: Integrations & API → API Keys

api_token.title: Aircall API Token
api_token.description: The token shown when the API key is created

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Only allow reading data (no creating, updating, deleting, calling or messaging)
